pick.headline: Indira Gandhi assassinated by her bodyguards
pick.summary: On 31 October 1984 Indian Prime Minister Indira Gandhi was shot dead in New Delhi by two of her Sikh bodyguards.
pick.significance: Her killing, months after the army stormed the Golden Temple, set off anti-Sikh massacres. Her son Rajiv succeeded her.

evidence.snippet: FBIS MIDDLE EAST & SOUTH DAILY REPORT ASIA REVIEW 31 OCTOBER 1984 INDIA The prime minister of India, Mrs Indira Gandhi, was shot and killed by two of her own security men at her home this morning, according to Delhi radio.
